description: Get aggregated Email Marketing statistics (sent, delivery, bounce, open, click, spam and unsubscription counts and rates) across campaigns and/or automations for a date range; optionally filter by domain, source (campaigns or automations) or email service provider. Rates are fractions from 0 to 1: `delivery_rate` and `bounce_rate` are shares of `sent_count`, the other rates are shares of `delivery_count`. Email API/SMTP traffic is reported by get-sending-stats instead.

email_service_providers.description: Optional filter: limit to these email service providers (e.g. Google, Yahoo, Outlook).

end_date.description: End of the date range (inclusive), in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

sending_domain_ids.description: Optional filter: limit to these domain IDs, as returned by list-domains.

sources.description: Optional filter: `campaigns` or `automations` narrows the stats to that source; omit it, or pass both, for all Email Marketing traffic.

start_date.description: Start of the date range (inclusive), in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.

name: get-marketing-stats
